name: Dropdead
description: '''Dropdead''' is an American [[hardcore punk]] band based in [[Providence, Rhode Island]]. They have been active in the [[punk rock|punk]] scene since 1991, having been formed in January of that year. The band's songs are generally short and very fast-paced, with few lasting longer than two minutes. Other famous [[crust punk]] and [[grindcore]] bands like [[Nasum]] have covered some of their songs.  The band has a strong [[do it yourself|DIY]] ethic.
